title: 19-BCV-003(REV1) - Elevator and passenger-elevating devices
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); joint reference to Alberta Elevating Devices requirements

facts.text: The revision addresses use of a passenger elevator instead of a CSA B355 platform or stair lift for barrier-free access.

The substitution applies only where a lift would meet the NBC(AE) accessibility requirements; the passenger elevator may avoid the usual stretcher dimensions only when vertical travel is no more than 7,000 mm and car dimensions meet CSA B355 Table 1 minimums.
The variance requires applicants to provide the document to the AHJ and explains the Firefighters’ Emergency Operation exception for travel of 7,000 mm or less.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
